value.rationale: The primary 2026 paper identifies a natural sharp avoidability threshold and one witness. The number and rigidity of all maximum-length witnesses are an intrinsic follow-up extremal classification, not an artificial restricted sample: exactly 20 words remain, 21 of 29 positions are forced identically, and the other eight admit eight concise disjoint families. These facts quantify extremal nonuniqueness and give useful complete boundary examples for alternative equivalence-based repetition avoidance, despite not producing a theorem for longer alphabets.
